saveDraft.error: Couldn't save your draft. Check your connection and try again.
saveDraft.codeBody: Use this code to continue this report from another device or browser. Keep it safe — anyone with this code can open this draft. It stops working after 7 days.

meta.title: Resume a saved report: Cybercrime Report & Track
meta.description: Continue a report you saved earlier using your resume code.

resumeByCode.heading: Resume a saved report
resumeByCode.description: Paste the resume code you saved earlier.
resumeByCode.codeError: Enter the resume code exactly as it was shown to you.
resumeByCode.notFound: We couldn't find a draft for that code. It may have expired (drafts are kept for 7 days) or the code may not be exact.
resumeByCode.unsupportedType: This draft was started in a part of the reporting flow that doesn't support resuming yet.
resumeByCode.linkPrompt: Already started a report on another device?

narrate.title: Tell us what happened
narrate.description: Write it in your own words. There's no right way to say it, and no minimum length.
narrate.narrativePlaceholder: I got a call saying my KYC expired. They sent a link. ₹18,000 left my account.
narrate.narrativeError: Tell us what happened; even a rough description helps.
narrate.smsPlaceholder: Rs 18,000 debited from A/c XX1234 on 24-08-26. UPI Ref No 512345678901.
narrate.smsHelp: This helps us find the amount and transaction reference automatically. Fully optional.

facts.title: Confirm the facts
facts.description: We pulled this from what you told us, nothing is invented. Every field below quotes the exact words it came from, so check it, fix anything wrong, and confirm the category.
facts.lowConfidenceNote: We're not fully sure about this one, please double-check before confirming.
facts.amountError: Enter the amount that was taken.
facts.instrumentPlaceholder: e.g. HDFC Bank, or a UPI ID
facts.categoryError: Please confirm or change the category above.

contact.title: Where + how to reach you
contact.description: That's all we ask. No ID, no parent's name, no date of birth.

mobileConsent.what: Send your Complaint ID and status updates on this case.
mobileConsent.who: The police unit your complaint is routed to. Nobody else.
mobileConsent.required: No. You still get your Complaint ID either way; this only adds SMS updates.

contact.savedFromProfileBody: We've filled in the state and district from your last report. You can change them.

evidence.title: Add evidence
evidence.description: Completely optional, your report is already valid without it. Screenshots, bank statements (PDF is fine), call logs, chat exports: whatever you have.
evidence.helperText: Images and PDFs, up to {maxSize} each, up to {maxFiles} files. Images are compressed on your device before upload.
evidence.reattachTitle: Files you had attached weren't restored
evidence.reattachBody: This page reloaded, and browsers can't keep selected files across a refresh. You had attached: {names}. Please re-attach {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}, or add the text fallback below if you can't.
evidence.tooManyFiles: You can attach up to {maxFiles} files.
evidence.unsupportedType: “{name}” isn't an image or PDF. You can skip evidence and submit without it.
evidence.scanNoticeBody: Your files are checked for type and size, then marked “simulated clean”. No antivirus actually runs here, in a working system, this is exactly where malware scanning would sit, before a file ever reaches an officer.
evidence.filesSelectedCount: {count, plural, =0 {No files selected} one {# file selected} other {# files selected}}
evidence.textFallbackLabel: Nothing to upload? Paste the details instead
evidence.textFallbackHelp: Message headers, phone numbers, UPI IDs, transaction references, links: anything you can copy but not screenshot. This gets added to your report.
evidence.textFallbackPlaceholder: e.g. Received a call from +91 XXXXX XXXXX claiming to be my bank...

review.title: Review
review.description: Here's what we'll send. Nothing is filed until you submit.
review.categoryLine: We think this is {label}. Is that right?
review.contactLine: You're in {district}, {state}. We'll reach you at {mobile}.
review.evidenceNone: No evidence attached. That's fine, it's optional.
review.evidenceAttached: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} attached: {files}
review.evidenceTextOnly: No files, but you pasted additional details. They'll be added to your report.

done.idCardDescription: Large, copyable, and yours to keep.
done.smsPreviewLabel: Here's the SMS we'd send you (simulated, nothing is actually sent)
done.evidenceDone: Your files are checked for type and size, then marked “simulated clean”. No antivirus actually runs here, in a working system, this is exactly where malware scanning would sit, before a file ever reaches an officer.
done.evidencePartial: Some evidence files were attached; others couldn't be saved (unsupported type or too large). Your report itself was still filed.
done.evidenceError: Evidence couldn't be attached, but your report was still filed successfully.
done.checklistTitle: Do these 3 things in the next hour
done.checklist1: Call your bank's fraud helpline and ask them to flag the transaction.
done.checklist2: Don't delete the messages, calls, or app related to this; they may be needed later.
done.checklist3: Don't trust anyone who calls claiming to be police about this complaint; verify through 1930 first.
done.nextBody: Your report has been received and is queued for review. This Complaint ID is not an FIR: it is a record that a report was made and is the reference your bank and the cyber cell will use.
done.updatesDescription: Optional. Verify your number and we'll link this report to it so you can check on it later. Skip if you'd rather not.
done.updatesLinkedBody: Your number is verified and linked to this report.
done.updatesSkipped: Skipped: your Complaint ID above still works on its own.
done.demoCodeBody: No real SMS is sent. The code is shown on your screen instead. In a working system it would arrive by text, and the rest of this step would be identical.
done.otpGenericError: Something went wrong confirming that code. Please try again.
done.downloadFileBody:
Cybercrime Report: Confirmation

done.officeTitle: If you want to follow up in person
done.officeCaveat: This unit is invented for the prototype, and nothing you filed here was sent to it. To reach a real cyber cell, call 1930.

reasons.kycOtpLink: We think this because you mentioned KYC, an OTP or verification code, a link that expired or needed verifying, or an account/card that was going to be blocked or suspended.
reasons.investment: We think this because you mentioned an investment, trading, or crypto opportunity.
reasons.card: We think this because you mentioned a debit or credit card.
reasons.upi: We think this because you mentioned UPI, PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, or BHIM.
reasons.netBanking: We think this because you mentioned internet/net banking.
reasons.noPatternDetected: We couldn't detect a specific pattern from what you told us; please confirm or change this.
reasons.digitalArrest: We think this because you mentioned someone claiming to be from the police, CBI, customs or a court. Nobody from any of those can arrest you over a video call, and no real agency asks for a transfer to “verify” your money.
reasons.jobTask: We think this because you mentioned a part-time job, work from home, or paid tasks. Being asked to deposit money before you can withdraw your earnings is the scam.
reasons.matrimonial: We think this because you mentioned someone you met through a matrimonial site, dating app, or a long online relationship.
